initial_saved_dxf_regression.scope: Initial 25 integration cases on rc30 before implementation; six missing-text failures, not all 65 final tests.

dependency_regression.scope: Seven later cases before verified-result chaining; four mixed enclosing/half-enclosing misses and one bounded-chain miss.

bridge_font_regression.scope: A whole glyph shared by two catalogs must retain the font that actually proved its radical before becoming a bridge.

matching_face_pdf.method: Each published glyph label/source handles and bbox checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen excluding move-only contours without any segments at the PDF generation position; original DXF entity tags compared to rc30 in all cases after removing only recovery layer/XDATA. No source fonts used by runtime matching.

all_ten_saved_dxf.method: Fresh recognition of the same 84 saved DXFs with all ten verified unchanged r2 catalogs cached. Source geometry compared in every case; unchanged text cases compare every other recognition field and entitydb tag except writer time. Enclosure diagnostics/proof fields intentionally change. Not 84 PDF conversions.

changed_case_independent_audit.method: Each published glyph label/source handles and bbox checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen excluding move-only contours without any segments at the PDF generation position; original DXF entity tags compared to rc30 in all cases after removing only recovery layer/XDATA. No source fonts used by runtime matching.

existing_long_pdf.method: Four real open fonts; 97/193-character 20pt stroke and filled-Bezier PDFs with original advances. Normal Converter resource loading. Same original PDF bytes as rc30; compare saved rc30 source entity tags and text. Converter sampling and r2 catalogs are unchanged; the current local row evidence pipeline is exercised. Every glyph is checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen at its PDF position, with complete source handles/digests and saved TEXT insertion/alignment endpoints. Font files are used only to generate/audit fixtures, never by runtime recognition.

algorithm.half_enclosure: One valid radical polygon and valid remaining polygons are disjoint. Their convex hulls overlap without containment; remaining bounds protrude through exactly one side and stay strictly inside the other three.
algorithm.label_evidence: Exact complete glyph and actual canonical radical cmap outline in the independently locked catalog; Python Unicode NFKC identifies the Kangxi radical. Compatibility glyphs need not share the same drawing. Closed counters retain the prior exact alias-geometry check.
algorithm.proof_chains: Only prior-round verified matches can connect a later proof, restricted to the catalog that proved them. They never supply anchors. Every proof reaches three distinct original uncontested Han anchors within 96 adjacent glyphs; at most 96 rounds.
algorithm.diagnostics: Geometry bounds, open side, part separation, convex-hull overlap area, canonical/compatibility codepoints, proof round, verified bridge catalogs and source handles. Details capped at 32, with separate truncation counts.

hundred_percent_scope: 84 existing matching-face font PDF probes only. Not all-ten-catalog completeness, arbitrary-font coverage or engineering acceptance.
